_comment: Wording lab: candidate wordings for the selfie mode (docs/ROADMAP.md, F4),
rendered side by side by tools/wortlabor.py. Nothing here is a preset yet:
a wording moves into PRESETS only after the user's verdict on the sheets.
basis: the example workflow's person, wardrobe, scene, lighting, style and
template (tools/baue_workflow.py), composed by the real builders. Each
candidate replaces one prompt slot (camera, expression, style or pose);
the group's 'feste' fill the other slots. A value is a text, or
{"kandidat": id} for another candidate's wording, {"preset": "cat/Label"}
for a built-in entry of the slot's builder, or {"basis": true} for what
the base puts into that slot. A candidate's own feste win over the group's
(the mirror selfies look at the screen, not into the lens). kontrolle marks
the bare-word control row. A group's zusatz composes builder fields with
each candidate of its slot, the candidate standing in for 'feld' - mood
and gaze in one expression, as a series sends them; "zusatz": null opts
a candidate out.
bildausschnitt is the framing label (nodes/shooting.py KAMERA): the person
block is shortened for it, and with kamera_mit_ausschnitt the camera slot
starts with the Series' wording for it, the camera value appended - the
way the planned Perspektive field will append to the framing (ROADMAP F4).
Groups A and B run without a style text, so no lens description competes
with the selfie; the example's editorial style is group C's control.
